blocks.zh: 第三節：公用系統、清潔確效、變更管控與術語表
blocks.en: Section 3: Utilities, Cleaning Validation, Change Control and Glossary

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解公用系統確效（§8）的階段性方法及季節性變化考量
blocks.en: Understand the phased approach to utility qualification (§8) and the consideration of seasonal variation

blocks.zh: 掌握測試方法確效（§9）對分析回收率與微生物方法的特殊要求
blocks.en: Understand the special requirements of test method validation (§9) for analytical recovery and microbiological methods

blocks.zh: 深入理解清潔確效（§10）的完整框架：殘留限度計算、取樣方法、最壞情況選擇
blocks.en: Gain an in-depth understanding of the complete cleaning validation framework (§10): residue limit calculation, sampling methods and worst case selection

blocks.zh: 熟悉變更管控（§11）與 Annex 15 確效狀態的整合方式
blocks.en: Become familiar with how change control (§11) integrates with the validated status under Annex 15

blocks.zh: 掌握本附錄所有關鍵術語的正式定義，以確保法規溝通精準性
blocks.en: Master the formal definitions of all key terms in this Annex, to ensure precise regulatory communication

blocks.zh: 公用系統確效 — Steam, water, air, gases
blocks.en: Utilities Qualification — Steam, water, air, gases

blocks.zh: 公用系統確效解析
blocks.en: Utilities Qualification Explained

blocks.zh: 公用系統的 IQ/OQ/PQ 應用
blocks.en: Applying IQ/OQ/PQ to Utilities

blocks.zh: §8.1 指明公用系統的確效使用第3節描述的相同架構（URS → DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ）。常見公用系統：
blocks.en: §8.1 states that utilities are qualified using the same framework described in Section 3 (URS → DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ). Common utility systems:

blocks.zh: PW/WFI：注射用水/純化水（最嚴格）
blocks.en: PW/WFI: purified water / water for injections (the most stringent)

blocks.zh: Pure Steam：純蒸汽（直接接觸產品）
blocks.en: Pure Steam: pure steam (in direct contact with product)

blocks.zh: Compressed Air：壓縮空氣（油分/微粒/微生物）
blocks.en: Compressed Air: compressed air (oil / particles / microorganisms)

blocks.zh: HVAC：暖通空調（環境控制）
blocks.en: HVAC: heating, ventilation and air conditioning (environmental control)

blocks.zh: Nitrogen/CO₂：惰性氣體（保護填充）
blocks.en: Nitrogen/CO₂: inert gases (protective filling)

blocks.zh: 季節性變化（§8.2）
blocks.en: Seasonal Variation (§8.2)

blocks.zh: 某些公用系統的性能受季節影響：夏季冷卻水溫度升高影響 WFI 系統；冬季外氣條件影響 HVAC 除濕能力。確效計畫需涵蓋最嚴苛的季節條件，或說明全年均已測試。
blocks.en: The performance of some utilities is affected by the season: higher cooling water temperature in summer affects the WFI system; outdoor air conditions in winter affect the dehumidification capacity of HVAC. The qualification plan must cover the most demanding seasonal conditions, or explain that testing has been carried out throughout the year.

blocks.zh: 直接/間接接觸的風險評估（§8.3）
blocks.en: Risk Assessment of Direct/Indirect Contact (§8.3)

blocks.zh: 直接接觸：HVAC（空氣直接接觸開放產品）→ 最高風險，需確認微粒和微生物符合潔淨等級要求
blocks.en: Direct contact: HVAC (air in direct contact with open product) → highest risk; particles and microorganisms must be confirmed to meet the cleanliness grade requirements

blocks.zh: 間接接觸：熱交換器（冷卻水通過金屬壁加熱/冷卻產品）→ 需確認無滲漏風險
blocks.en: Indirect contact: heat exchangers (cooling water heating/cooling product through a metal wall) → the risk of leakage must be ruled out

blocks.zh: 測試方法確效 — Detection limits, microbial methods & recovery
blocks.en: Test Method Validation — Detection limits, microbial methods & recovery

blocks.zh: 測試方法確效解析
blocks.en: Test Method Validation Explained

blocks.zh: 方法確效的基準：PIC/S GMP Part I Chapter 6
blocks.en: Basis for Method Validation: PIC/S GMP Part I Chapter 6

blocks.zh: 所有用於確效/清潔確效的分析方法，需依據 Part I 第6章（品質控制）進行確效，需確立：
blocks.en: All analytical methods used for validation/cleaning validation must be validated in accordance with Part I Chapter 6 (Quality Control), establishing:

blocks.zh: 偵測極限（LOD）：最小可偵測量
blocks.en: Limit of detection (LOD): the smallest amount that can be detected

blocks.zh: 定量極限（LOQ）：可準確定量的最小量
blocks.en: Limit of quantification (LOQ): the smallest amount that can be accurately quantified

blocks.zh: 線性、專一性、準確性、精密性、耐用性
blocks.en: linearity, specificity, accuracy, precision and robustness

blocks.zh: 微生物方法的特殊要求（§9.2-9.3）
blocks.en: Special Requirements for Microbiological Methods (§9.2-9.3)

blocks.zh: 產品抑制測試（§9.2）：某些藥品成分（防腐劑、抗菌成分）可能抑制微生物生長，導致無菌測試假陰性。需通過「適用性測試」確認產品基質不影響回收率。
blocks.en: Product inhibition testing (§9.2): some product ingredients (preservatives, antimicrobial components) may inhibit microbial growth and cause false negatives in sterility tests. A suitability test is needed to confirm that the product matrix does not affect recovery.

blocks.zh: 消毒劑干擾（§9.3）：環境監測時，表面殘留的消毒劑可能抑制接觸平板（contact plate）上的微生物生長。需確認取樣方法能有效中和殘留消毒劑（使用中和劑如卵磷脂+吐溫）。
blocks.en: Disinfectant interference (§9.3): in environmental monitoring, disinfectant residues on surfaces may inhibit microbial growth on contact plates. It must be confirmed that the sampling method effectively neutralizes residual disinfectant (using neutralizers such as lecithin + polysorbate 80).

blocks.zh: 清潔確效 — Residue limits, sampling, worst case & hold times
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation — Residue limits, sampling, worst case & hold times

blocks.zh: 清潔確效核心要求解析
blocks.en: Core Requirements of Cleaning Validation Explained

blocks.zh: HBEL/ADE 為殘留限度設定依據（§10.6）
blocks.en: HBEL/ADE as the Basis for Setting Residue Limits (§10.6)

blocks.zh: 產品殘留限度（carryover limits）必須基於毒理學評估（toxicological evaluation），即：
blocks.en: Product residue limits (carryover limits) must be based on a toxicological evaluation, i.e.:

blocks.zh: ADE（Acceptable Daily Exposure）：可接受日暴露量
blocks.en: ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure): the acceptable daily exposure

blocks.zh: HBEL（Health-Based Exposure Limit）：基於健康的暴露限值（EU EMA 指南用語）
blocks.en: HBEL (Health-Based Exposure Limit): a health-based exposure limit (the term used in the EU EMA guideline)

blocks.zh: PDE（Permitted Daily Exposure）：ICH Q3C 用語，同概念
blocks.en: PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure): the term used in ICH Q3C; the same concept

blocks.zh: 傳統的 1/1000 劑量法（1/1000 dose criterion）已不符合現行要求，必須採用 HBEL/ADE。
blocks.en: The traditional 1/1000 dose criterion no longer meets current requirements; HBEL/ADE must be used.

blocks.zh: §10.6.1 大分子/多肽的特例
blocks.en: §10.6.1 Special Case: Large Molecules/Peptides

blocks.zh: 治療性蛋白質和多肽（如單株抗體、胰島素）在 pH 極端或高溫下會降解失活，因此傳統毒理學計算（基於藥理活性）可能不適用。此情況下，可採用替代評估方法，如過敏原性評估或更保守的一般蛋白質殘留限度。
blocks.en: Therapeutic proteins and peptides (such as monoclonal antibodies and insulin) degrade and lose activity at extreme pH or high temperature, so traditional toxicological calculations (based on pharmacological activity) may not be applicable. In such cases, alternative assessment approaches may be used, such as an allergenicity assessment or a more conservative general protein residue limit.

blocks.zh: 目視檢查不夠（§10.2）
blocks.en: Visual Inspection Is Not Enough (§10.2)

blocks.zh: 目視清潔度檢查雖然是 AC 的一部分，但不能作為清潔確效的唯一驗收標準。必須搭配化學殘留分析（HPLC/UV/TOC）和/或微生物限度測試。
blocks.en: Although visual cleanliness inspection is part of the AC, it cannot be the sole acceptance criterion for cleaning validation. It must be combined with chemical residue analysis (HPLC/UV/TOC) and/or microbial limit testing.

blocks.zh: 重要禁止條款：「反覆清潔和重新測試直至達到可接受殘留結果」的做法是不可接受的。清潔確效必須基於預先定義的清潔程序，而非靠重複嘗試達標。
blocks.en: Important prohibition: the practice of "repeated cleaning and retesting until an acceptable residue result is achieved" is not acceptable. Cleaning validation must be based on a predefined cleaning procedure, not on repeated attempts until the limit is met.

blocks.zh: 比喻：TOC 作為替代指標
blocks.en: Analogy: TOC as a Surrogate Indicator

blocks.zh: 當產品殘留難以直接測量（如複雜天然產物或混合物），TOC（總有機碳）是常用替代指標：所有有機殘留都含碳，TOC 提供非專一性的「有機污染總量」指標。但需確認 TOC 方法對目標殘留的靈敏度。
blocks.en: When product residue is difficult to measure directly (such as complex natural products or mixtures), TOC (total organic carbon) is a commonly used surrogate: all organic residues contain carbon, so TOC gives a non-specific indicator of total organic contamination. However, the sensitivity of the TOC method for the target residue must be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 進階清潔確效主題解析
blocks.en: Advanced Cleaning Validation Topics Explained

blocks.zh: 最壞情況產品選擇（§10.10）
blocks.en: Worst Case Product Selection (§10.10)

blocks.zh: Worst Case Product 策略允許用一個（或幾個）代表性產品的清潔確效，涵蓋多個類似設備或製程。選擇最壞情況產品的標準：
blocks.en: The worst case product strategy allows the cleaning validation of one (or a few) representative products to cover multiple similar pieces of equipment or processes. The criteria for selecting the worst case product are:

blocks.zh: 低溶解度（難以沖洗清除）
blocks.en: Low solubility (difficult to rinse away)

blocks.zh: 低清潔性（如油脂類物質）
blocks.en: Poor cleanability (e.g. greasy substances)

blocks.zh: 高毒性/高效力（允許殘留量極低）
blocks.en: High toxicity/high potency (very low permitted residue)

blocks.zh: 高劑量（分母大，限度相對低）
blocks.en: High dose (a large denominator, so the limit is relatively low)

blocks.zh: 髒保留時間與潔淨保留時間（§10.8）
blocks.en: Dirty Hold Time and Clean Hold Time (§10.8)

blocks.zh: Dirty Hold Time（DHT）：從最後一批生產結束到開始清潔的最長允許時間。需確認產品殘留在此期間不會形成更難清潔的狀態（如乾燥結垢）。
blocks.en: Dirty Hold Time (DHT): the maximum permitted time from the end of the last batch of production until cleaning begins. It must be confirmed that product residues do not become harder to clean during this period (e.g. through drying and encrustation).

blocks.zh: Clean Hold Time（CHT）：清潔完成後到設備被使用前的最長允許存放時間。需確認清潔後的設備不會在存放期間被微生物污染。
blocks.en: Clean Hold Time (CHT): the maximum permitted storage time from completion of cleaning until the equipment is used. It must be confirmed that cleaned equipment is not contaminated by microorganisms during storage.

blocks.zh: 取樣回收率確認（§10.12）
blocks.en: Confirming Sampling Recovery (§10.12)

blocks.zh: 無論使用棉棒取樣（swab）還是沖洗取樣（rinse），都必須確認取樣方法的回收率（recovery），即：從設備表面材質中能回收多少比例的殘留物。殘留限度計算必須校正回收率，例如回收率 70%，則分析得出的殘留量需除以 0.7 得到真實殘留量。
blocks.en: Whether swab sampling or rinse sampling is used, the recovery of the sampling method must be confirmed, i.e. what proportion of the residue can be recovered from the equipment surface material. The residue limit calculation must be corrected for recovery; for example, with 70% recovery, the analytical result must be divided by 0.7 to obtain the true residue amount.

blocks.zh: 活動批次（Campaign）清潔的挑戰（§10.9）
blocks.en: The Challenge of Campaign Cleaning (§10.9)

blocks.zh: 連續生產同一產品多批次（campaign manufacture）後，殘留物可能更難清潔（長時間接觸、乾燥累積）。清潔確效應基於活動的最大長度（最多批次數或最長時間），以確保在最難清潔的情況下仍能達到清潔標準。
blocks.en: After consecutive production of the same product over multiple batches (campaign manufacture), residues may be harder to clean (long contact time, build-up through drying). Cleaning validation should be based on the maximum length of the campaign (the maximum number of batches or the longest duration), to ensure that the cleaning standard can still be met in the most difficult-to-clean situation.

blocks.zh: 變更管控 — Knowledge management & validation impact assessment
blocks.en: Change Control — Knowledge management & validation impact assessment

blocks.zh: 變更管控與確效的整合
blocks.en: Integrating Change Control and Validation

blocks.zh: 變更管控的廣泛觸發範圍（§11.2）
blocks.en: Broad Range of Change Control Triggers (§11.2)

blocks.zh: 以下任何變更都可能觸發確效影響評估：
blocks.en: Any of the following changes may trigger a validation impact assessment:

blocks.zh: 起始物料或包材（供應商、規格）
blocks.en: starting materials or packaging materials (supplier, specification)

blocks.zh: 製程（參數、設備、廠房）
blocks.en: the process (parameters, equipment, facility)

blocks.zh: 批次規模
blocks.en: batch size

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）
blocks.en: the design space

blocks.zh: 生產或測試方法
blocks.en: production or test methods

blocks.zh: 任何影響產品品質或重現性的變更
blocks.en: any change affecting product quality or reproducibility

blocks.zh: 設計空間變更的雙軌評估（§11.3）
blocks.en: Two-track Assessment of Design Space Changes (§11.3)

blocks.zh: 若使用了 Design Space（ICH Q8），變更需進行兩層評估：
blocks.en: If a design space (ICH Q8) is used, changes require assessment at two levels:

blocks.zh: 科學評估：變更是否超出已確立的設計空間？
blocks.en: Scientific assessment: does the change go outside the established design space?

blocks.zh: 法規評估：是否超出已向法規機構登記/批准的設計空間？
blocks.en: Regulatory assessment: does it go outside the design space registered/approved with the regulatory authority?

blocks.zh: 在已批准的設計空間內移動不算法規層面的變更，但若超出則需申報。
blocks.en: Moving within the approved design space is not a change from the regulatory standpoint, but moving outside it requires a regulatory submission.

blocks.zh: 變更有效性評估（§11.7）
blocks.en: Assessing the Effectiveness of Changes (§11.7)

blocks.zh: 變更實施後，需評估變更是否達到預期效果。例如：若設備升級是為了改善清潔效果，則需確認實際清潔殘留數據確實改善。這形成 PDCA（計畫-執行-確認-行動）的閉環管理。
blocks.en: After a change is implemented, it must be assessed whether the change achieved the intended effect. For example, if an equipment upgrade was intended to improve cleaning, it must be confirmed that actual cleaning residue data have improved. This forms a closed-loop PDCA (plan-do-check-act) management cycle.

blocks.zh: 術語表 — Official definitions for key qualification & validation terms
blocks.en: Glossary — Official definitions for key qualification & validation terms

blocks.zh: 術語表使用說明
blocks.en: Notes on Using the Glossary

blocks.zh: 本節定義了 Annex 15 中使用但在 PIC/S GMP 指南其他部分未定義的術語。標有 (ICH Q8)、(ICH Q9)、(ICH Q10) 的定義直接來源於對應 ICH 指南，確保與國際法規標準保持一致。
blocks.en: This section defines terms used in Annex 15 that are not defined elsewhere in the PIC/S GMP Guide. Definitions marked (ICH Q8), (ICH Q9) or (ICH Q10) are taken directly from the corresponding ICH guideline, to ensure consistency with international regulatory standards.

blocks.zh: Bracketing Approach（括弧法）
blocks.en: Bracketing Approach

blocks.zh: 科學與風險基礎的確效方法：僅測試某些預定設計因子（如規格、批次大小、包裝規格）的極端值，假設任何中間值均由極端值的確效所代表。
blocks.en: A science and risk based validation approach such that only batches on the extremes of certain predetermined design factors (e.g. strength, batch size and/or pack size) are tested, on the assumption that validation of any intermediate level is represented by validation of the extremes.

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更管控）
blocks.en: Change Control

blocks.zh: 由相關部門合格代表審查可能影響設施、系統、設備或製程確效狀態的擬議或實際變更的正式系統。目的是確定是否需要採取行動，以確保系統維持在確效狀態並加以記錄。
blocks.en: A formal system by which qualified representatives of appropriate disciplines review proposed or actual changes that might affect the validated status of facilities, systems, equipment or processes. The intent is to determine the need for action that would ensure the system is maintained in a validated state, and to document it.

blocks.zh: Cleaning Validation（清潔確效）
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的証據，証明已核准的清潔程序可重複性地將設備中前一產品或清潔劑的殘留量減少至科學設定的最大允許攜帶量以下。
blocks.en: Documented evidence that an approved cleaning procedure will reproducibly reduce residues of the previous product or cleaning agents in equipment to below the scientifically set maximum allowable carryover.

blocks.zh: Cleaning Verification（清潔查驗）
blocks.en: Cleaning Verification

blocks.zh: 在每批/每活動批次後通過化學分析收集証據，以証明前一產品或清潔劑的殘留量已減少至科學設定的最大允許攜帶量以下。（注意：不同於清潔「確效」）
blocks.en: The gathering of evidence through chemical analysis after each batch/campaign to show that the residues of the previous product or cleaning agents have been reduced below the scientifically set maximum allowable carryover. (Note: this differs from cleaning "validation".)

blocks.zh: Concurrent Validation（同步確效）
blocks.en: Concurrent Validation

blocks.zh: 在例外情況下，基於患者重大受益的理由，在確效批次商業化的同時執行確效協議的確效。
blocks.en: Validation carried out in exceptional circumstances, justified on the basis of significant patient benefit, where the validation protocol is executed concurrently with commercialization of the validation batches.

blocks.zh: Continuous Process Verification（持續性製程查驗）
blocks.en: Continuous Process Verification

blocks.zh: 傳統製程確效的替代方法，持續監測和評估製造製程性能。(ICH Q8)
blocks.en: An alternative approach to traditional process validation in which manufacturing process performance is continuously monitored and evaluated. (ICH Q8)

blocks.zh: Control Strategy（管控策略）
blocks.en: Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 來自目前產品和製程理解、確保製程性能和產品品質的計畫性管控集合。管控可包括起始物料和藥品材料與組件的相關參數和屬性、設施設備操作條件、製程中管控、成品規格以及相關監測與管控方法和頻率。(ICH Q10)
blocks.en: A planned set of controls, derived from current product and process understanding, that assures process performance and product quality. The controls can include parameters and attributes related to drug substance and drug product materials and components, facility and equipment operating conditions, in-process controls, finished product specifications, and the associated methods and frequency of monitoring and control. (ICH Q10)

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameter — CPP（關鍵製程參數）
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameter — CPP

blocks.zh: 其可變性對關鍵品質屬性有影響，因此應被監測或管控以確保製程產生所需品質的製程參數。(ICH Q8)
blocks.en: A process parameter whose variability has an impact on a critical quality attribute and therefore should be monitored or controlled to ensure the process produces the desired quality. (ICH Q8)

blocks.zh: Critical Quality Attribute — CQA（關鍵品質屬性）
blocks.en: Critical Quality Attribute — CQA

blocks.zh: 應在核准的限度、範圍或分佈內，以確保所需產品品質的物理、化學、生物或微生物性質或特性。(ICH Q8)
blocks.en: A physical, chemical, biological or microbiological property or characteristic that should be within an appropriate limit, range or distribution to ensure the desired product quality. (ICH Q8)

blocks.zh: Design Qualification — DQ（設計確效）
blocks.en: Design Qualification — DQ

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的驗證，証明設施、系統和設備的擬議設計適合預定目的。
blocks.en: The documented verification that the proposed design of the facilities, systems and equipment is suitable for the intended purpose.

blocks.zh: Design Space（設計空間）
blocks.en: Design Space

blocks.zh: 已被証明能提供品質保證的輸入變數（如物料屬性）和製程參數的多維組合與交互作用。在設計空間內的操作不被視為變更；移出設計空間則被視為變更，通常會啟動法規批准後變更程序。(ICH Q8)
blocks.en: The multidimensional combination and interaction of input variables (e.g. material attributes) and process parameters that have been demonstrated to provide assurance of quality. Working within the design space is not considered to be a change. Movement out of the design space is considered to be a change and would normally initiate a regulatory post-approval change process. (ICH Q8)

blocks.zh: Installation Qualification — IQ（安裝確效）
blocks.en: Installation Qualification — IQ

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的驗證，証明已安裝或修改的設施、系統和設備符合核准的設計和製造商的建議。
blocks.en: The documented verification that the facilities, systems and equipment, as installed or modified, comply with the approved design and the manufacturer's recommendations.

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management（知識管理）
blocks.en: Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: 獲取、分析、儲存和傳播資訊的系統方法。(ICH Q10)
blocks.en: A systematic approach to acquiring, analysing, storing and disseminating information. (ICH Q10)

blocks.zh: Lifecycle（生命週期）
blocks.en: Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 產品、設備或設施從初始開發或使用到停止使用的所有階段。
blocks.en: All phases in the life of a product, equipment or facility from initial development or use through to discontinuation of use.

blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Verification — OPV（持續性製程查驗）
blocks.en: Ongoing Process Verification — OPV

blocks.zh: 記錄製程在商業生產期間維持在管控狀態的証據（亦稱 continued process verification）。
blocks.en: Documented evidence that the process remains in a state of control during commercial manufacture (also called continued process verification).

blocks.zh: Operational Qualification — OQ（操作確效）
blocks.en: Operational Qualification — OQ

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的驗證，証明已安裝或修改的設施、系統和設備在預期操作範圍內如設計般運作。
blocks.en: The documented verification that the facilities, systems and equipment, as installed or modified, perform as intended throughout the anticipated operating ranges.

blocks.zh: Performance Qualification — PQ（性能確效）
blocks.en: Performance Qualification — PQ

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的驗證，証明系統和設備能根據核准的製程方法和產品規格有效且可重複地執行。
blocks.en: The documented verification that systems and equipment can perform effectively and reproducibly based on the approved process method and product specification.

blocks.zh: Process Validation（製程確效）
blocks.en: Process Validation

blocks.zh: 有文件記錄的証據，証明在已確立的參數內操作的製程，能有效且可重複地生產符合其預定規格和品質屬性的藥品。
blocks.en: The documented evidence that the process, operated within established parameters, can perform effectively and reproducibly to produce a medicinal product meeting its predetermined specifications and quality attributes.

blocks.zh: Quality by Design — QbD（品質源自設計）
blocks.en: Quality by Design — QbD

blocks.zh: 從預定義目標出發，強調以健全的科學和品質風險管理為基礎的產品和製程理解與製程管控的系統方法。
blocks.en: A systematic approach to development that begins with predefined objectives and emphasizes product and process understanding and process control, based on sound science and quality risk management.

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理）
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 跨生命週期評估、管控、溝通和審查品質風險的系統化過程。(ICH Q9)
blocks.en: A systematic process for the assessment, control, communication and review of risks to quality across the lifecycle. (ICH Q9)

blocks.zh: State of Control（管控狀態）
blocks.en: State of Control

blocks.zh: 一組管控措施持續提供可接受製程性能和產品品質保證的條件。
blocks.en: A condition in which the set of controls consistently provides assurance of continued process performance and product quality.

blocks.zh: User Requirements Specification — URS（使用者需求規格）
blocks.en: User Requirements Specification — URS

blocks.zh: 創建符合系統預定目的之可行設計所必要且足夠的業主、使用者和工程需求集合。
blocks.en: The set of owner, user and engineering requirements necessary and sufficient to create a feasible design meeting the intended purpose of the system.

blocks.zh: Worst Case（最壞情況）
blocks.en: Worst Case

blocks.zh: 在標準操作程序範圍內，包含上下處理限度和情況的條件或一組條件，與理想條件相比，最有可能導致產品或製程失敗的情況。此類條件不一定會實際引起產品或製程失敗。
blocks.en: A condition or set of conditions encompassing upper and lower processing limits and circumstances, within standard operating procedures, which pose the greatest chance of product or process failure when compared to ideal conditions. Such conditions do not necessarily induce product or process failure.
